row_indices_refer_to: rows of the processed dataset written by run_prepare_data.py (colated_tensors). Its row order follows the file listing at build time, so the class sequence of the rows is given in labels_by_row.
procedure: for held-out class h: ID rows = rows whose class is not h, in dataset order; label2id = sorted ID classes; train/eval = sklearn train_test_split(train_size=0.8, stratify=label, random_state=seed); OOD = all rows of class h; Letter-only eval = eval rows of class Letter
